page.overview:
Who is Donaea?

was a dragonborn cleric of the Moonweaver, and the partner of Erro Mordaurum.

She was a dragonborn woman with scales as white as snow. She had a holy symbol of the goddess of the moon carved from gray-white stone.

Despite living in an apocalyptic world, she believed that change was coming.

Donaea lived during the Calamity as a cleric of the Moonweaver, and had a very hard life. She met Erro Mordaurum, an equally exhausted dragonborn man, next to a lake in Gwessar, and they stayed together for a year, becoming partners and making the lake their home even if they traveled together several times.
